Bhai, ab aate hain Topic 2: Arrow Functions () => {} par. Yeh JavaScript ka sabse stylish aur modern tareeqa hai function likhne ka.

Chalo pehle iska poora mamla samajhte hain, fir code karenge, aur aakhiri me iske mast short notes milenge.

Part 1: Arrow Function Kya Hai? (The Theory)

ES6 (2015) me JavaScript waalo ne socha ki yaar, baar-baar function aur return likh kar haath dard ho jata hai. Kuch aisa banate hain jo dekhne me chota ho aur likhne me makkhan.

To unhone Arrow Function nikaala. Isme se function keyword ko delete kar diya aur parameters ke aage ek teer (=>) laga diya.

The Magic Rules (Shortcuts):

1. No function keyword: Iski zaroorat hi nahi hai.

2. One Parameter Rule: Agar function me sirf ek hi input (parameter) ja raha hai, to tum brackets () ko bhi hata sakte ho.

3. One Line Rule: Agar function ke andar sirf ek hi line ka code hai, to curly braces {} aur return keyword dono ko hata do. JavaScript apne aap samajh jayega ki is line ko return karna hai! (Isko Implicit Return bolte hain).

Part 2: Code Karke Dekhte Hain

Chalo ek normal function expression ko step-by-step Arrow Function me badalte hain.

1. Normal Tareeqa (Purana)

```javascript
const double = function(number) {
 return number * 2;
};
console.log(double(5)); // Output: 10
```

2. Arrow Function (Pehle step me badla)

Humne function hataya aur => lagaya:

```javascript
const doubleArrow = (number) => {
 return number * 2;
};
```

3. Ekdum Pro Tareeqa (Shortcut lagakar)

Kyunki sirf ek parameter hai (number) aur ek hi line ka kaam hai (number * 2), sab f ◌ालतू cheezein uda do:

```javascript
const doublePro = number => number * 2;
console.log(doublePro(5)); // Output: 10 (Ekdum clean!)
```

## Doubt: bhai kya hum ek hi reposotory me daily push kr skte hai ya daily alg a

Q: bhai kya hum ek hi reposotory me daily push kr skte hai ya daily alg alg repo bnai

Bhai, ekdum seedha aur saaf jawaab: Ek hi repository me daily push karo! Roz alag-alag repo banana bilkul sahi tareeqa nahi hai.

Agar tum roz naya repo banaoge to tumhare GitHub par 100 se zyada kachra repos ik ◌ੱ tha ho jayenge, aur tumhari profile dekhne wale ko kuch samajh nahi aayega ki kaun sa code kahan hai.

Chalo mai tumko batata hoon ki isko sahi tareeqe se ek hi repository me kaise manage karte hain:

📂 Ek Hi Repo Ko Sahi Se Rakhne Ka "Folder Tareeqa"

Tum ek main repository banao, jiska naam rakh do kuch aisa: learning-javascript ya js-mastery-journey.

Ab is repo ke andar tum Daily Folders banao. Jaise:

learning-javascript/ (Main Repo)

📂 Day-01-Variables/

📂 Day-02-DataTypes/

📂 Day-03-Functions-In-Depth/ (Isme aaj ka code daal do!)

📂 Day-04-Objects/

💎 Is Tareeqe Ke 3 Sabse Bade Fayde

1. Clean Profile: Jab koi recruiter tumhara GitHub dekhega, use ek single, mast organized repository dikhegi jise dekh kar lagega ki ladka bohot systematic hai.

2. Easy Navigation: Tumhe khud kabhi purana code dekhna hua, to ek hi jagah saara maal mil jayega. Alag-alag repos me bhatakna nahi padega.

3. Green Dots (Contributions): Tum ek hi repo me roz naya folder banakar push karoge, GitHub tumko roz ka Green Dot (Commit) dega.

GitHub ko is baat se matlab nahi hai ki repo naya hai ya purana, use matlab hai ki kya aaj code push hua ya nahi.

🛠 Roz Push Karne Ka Command Process (Daily Routine)

Jab tum roz naya folder banakar usme code likh lo, to terminal me bas yeh 3 lines chalani hain:

# 1. Saare naye badlaav aur folders ko pakdo

git add .

# 2. Ek chota sa message likho ki aaj kya kiya

git commit -m "Day 3: Completed JS functions in-depth"

# 3. Cloud par bhej do

git push origin main
